name: Earth Zoom Out
blurb: Pulls back all the way to space.

shots.action: The scene shrinks away below: the road, the desert, the whole region, until the curve of the Earth fills the frame against black space.
shots.sound: A rising whoosh that fades into the silence of space.
shots.cameraText: The camera pulls straight up and away, faster and faster, through the clouds
shots.framing: the whole planet against black space
